name: SOL VolFavorite
description: eth-volfav2 code applied unchanged to SOL (same rule as xrp-volfav): buy the winning side late in the window when implied vol is far above the forecast; model and threshold refit monthly on SOL history.
hypothesis: Thinner, more retail 15m markets misprice vol (ETH, XRP passed; BTC efficient). SOL was only tested inside the 5-coin pool (which failed its lockbox, driven by BTC's inefficiency dilution) and with a different vomma model. Wrong if the full walk-forward is flat/negative, 2x latency loses, or the lockbox loses. No tuning on SOL.
next: smoke -> quick -> full -> lockbox if promising
